control_flow: followInTheDark: if RLIGHT < 60 then (if LLIGHT < 45 curve left; else if line tracker > 95 curve right; else avoidWalls) else avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if LLIGHT < 70 then (if obstacle LEFT turn right 20°; else if obstacle RIGHT turn left 20°; else driveInTheDark) else driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT < 70 drive forward 30 %; else stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if obstacle FRONT stop; else followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black curve left 10/40; else curve right 40/10.

likely_intent.description: In dim light (a tunnel), follow a black line when one is under the robot, otherwise drive straight; in bright light, follow the line.

dim: it checks the obstacle sensors

decision_points.condition: in avoidWalls in dim light: first obstacle LEFT, then obstacle RIGHT
